# Playbook: changes
Use when: owner-agent snapshot of a workspace, or "what changed since version <v>", with an LPM API key

How to run this playbook:
- Follow steps in order. CALL sends the shown arguments; RUN executes a command. FOR EACH repeats its indented lines.
- Replace `<input:x>` from You need, `<saved:x>` from SAVE, `<each:x>` from the current item. Whole placeholders retain their JSON type, including numbers, arrays, objects and null; embedded ones are text. Never invent concurrency tokens. `result` is the last call's response.
- IF tests a condition; go to step N jumps forward; go to Answer ends execution.
- ASK waits for the user's answer unless that exact action is already authorized. STOP ends calls and puts its message in Next. Owner-only actions require the owner's order.
- VERIFY must pass before reporting success. Fill the Answer block in the user's language; copy IDs exactly. Secrets never enter the reply. **Your entire reply is ONLY the Answer block — no other text.**

## You need
| Input | Where it comes from | If missing |
|---|---|---|
| workspaceId | the user or this session | "none" (step 2) |
| workspaceName | the workspace name the user gave | "none" |
| sinceVersion | the bundle version the user or your notes hold from an earlier run | "none" (any value that is not the current version returns the full bundle) |
| connector | "yes" when get_project_analytics is not in your tool list (ChatGPT/Claude connector) | "no" |

## Steps
Every CALL with no error line: IF it returns an error → STOP. Say: "Review incomplete: <tool> failed: <error text>."
1. IF <input:connector> == "yes" → STOP. Say: "The owner snapshot needs an LPM API key. On this connector, ask for a portfolio review instead."
2. IF <input:workspaceId> is not "none" → SAVE: workspaceId = <input:workspaceId>; go to step 4.
3. CALL `list_workspaces` {"compact":true} [A]
   SAVE: workspaceId = id of the only item, else of the one item whose name equals <input:workspaceName>, ignoring case (empty if none)
   IF <saved:workspaceId> is empty → STOP. Say: "Which workspace: <names of result>?"
4. CALL `get_workspace_owner_context_bundle` {"workspaceId":"<saved:workspaceId>","sinceVersion":"<input:sinceVersion>","detailLevel":"compact"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error containing "-32003" → STOP. Say: "The owner snapshot needs an LPM API key or agent credential; nothing was read."
   SAVE: version = result.version; changed = "no change since <input:sinceVersion>" when result.unchanged is true, else "changed"; itemRisks = "<itemId> <title> <priority>" per item of result.activeRisks, or "none"; repos = "<repositoryLinkId> <freshness>" per item of result.repositories with freshness "stale" or "unavailable", or "none"; projects = the number of items of result.projects
   Never report executive.mandate or executive.readiness: LPM always returns them null.
5. CALL `get_workspace_decision_inbox` {"workspaceId":"<saved:workspaceId>","requiresActionOnly":true} [A]
   Always make this call, also when nothing changed: new decisions do not change the bundle version.
   IF the call returns an error → SAVE: decisions = "not read"; go to step 6.
   SAVE: decisions = result.summary.actionRequiredCount
6. SAVE: pending = a line per row below that fired, in order; next = skill and action of the first line, else "none — nothing needs attention"
   ```text
   itemRisks is not "none" → lpm-roadmap: materialize or re-plan the urgent/high items — the owner
   repos is not "none" → lpm-code-index: re-scan or refresh the index — delivery lead or project owner
   decisions > 0 → lpm-governance-decisions — the owner
   ```

## Answer (reply with exactly this block, filled in; write nothing before or after it)
```text
Scope: <saved:workspaceId> / bundle version <saved:version>
Done: read-only snapshot; <saved:changed> | nothing read
Evidence: <projects <saved:projects>; roadmap risks <saved:itemRisks>; repositories <saved:repos> (get_workspace_owner_context_bundle); decisions <saved:decisions> (get_workspace_decision_inbox) | not read>
Pending: <the lines of <saved:pending> joined by " | " | none>
Next: <the ASK or STOP text that ended the run | <saved:next>>
```
The bundle has no health status: for health run playbook portfolio. Its budget field is today's code-search quota, not the AI budget; leave it out unless asked, then name lpm-ai-cost (the owner decides). Never claim a number or id that a step above did not read.
